resources.string: When a recording finishes, its words are sent to this conversation. Tap Listen for the next turn. Replies are spoken only when you turn this on.
Talk, then tap Send to send what you said. Listen starts your next turn.
Read replies aloud asks for your consent and a phone voice. You can stop reading at any time.
Leave voice mode stops listening and automatic reading. An uncertain send is never sent again automatically.
Tips could not be reset. Try again.
Tips could not be opened. Try again.
